releaseNotes:
• Seamless Next Up Song Pills: Redesigned song queue items with pure pill curves matching the Next Up button and eliminated rectangular background artifacts
• Smooth Album Morph Transition: Calibrated critically-damped spring mechanics eliminating snap or subtle jump when closing lyrics or queue
• Explore by Genre 'Show More': Added fluid navbar glass 'Show More' card with arrow for unlimited genre exploration, combining new releases and all-time classics
• Rich Top Charts with 2-Minute Cooldown: Expanded charts with 35–50+ tracks and smart 2-minute refresh throttling with tactile feedback
• Movie Soundtrack Albums in Search: Search songs to reveal their parent Bollywood and cinema movie soundtrack albums with full album UI and fluid shared-element morph animation
